approval: Alessandra must approve every page before it goes live. Personal connections need a separate yes, each time. Personal video is only for the highest match scores. Role pages have no form; the CTA is a mailto to alessandra@exhalemarketing.com. Do not send or submit anything without her approval.
voice: Warm, casual, plain, her words. No em dashes, no AI mention, nothing invented. Claims only from the resume or already-approved services-page copy.

pricing_rules.monthly_fee: max(CA$3000, half of the posted annual salary / 12). If the posting shows a range, use the midpoint, then say 'about half the posted salary range.' Keep the posting currency when possible. Never go below CA$3,000 a month, converting if the posting is not in CAD.
pricing_rules.pilot: Do not print a specific discount or ramp until Alessandra finalizes pilot terms. The page only says a short discounted pilot can be discussed once talking, with terms agreed together.
pricing_rules.claims: Do not treat the 18% to 15% churn figure as a nonprofit donor-retention result. It is customer churn, as on the services page. The current World Vision contract (Emergency Response Process Optimization Consultant, August 2026 to present) is emergency response process optimization only. Never imply it is marketing or donor communications work. Donor and marketing proof from World Vision comes only from the earlier Senior Marketing Advisor role on Impact Engine, March 2024 to October 2025. Do not invent World Vision, Stanley Park Ecology Society or Salvation Army titles, dates or metrics. Do not mention AI or the Anthropic certificate.

example.note: All sample filler in index.html is fictional and labelled EXAMPLE. Do not send or publish the Cedar & Tide Conservancy page.

fields.name: org_name
fields.what_fills_it: The organization's legal or commonly used name, exactly as they use it.
fields.source: The job posting, RFP, or the hiring contact's email.

fields.name: org_slug
fields.what_fills_it: A short lowercase hyphenated folder name for exhalemarketing.com/for/<org-slug>.
fields.source: Derived from org_name. Must be unique. Check the page list before publishing.

fields.name: page_url
fields.what_fills_it: The public URL once hosted on cPanel, usually https://exhalemarketing.com/for/{{org_slug}}.
fields.source: Built from org_slug after Alessandra approves the page.

fields.name: page_title
fields.what_fills_it: Browser title. Pattern: A note for {{org_name}} | Exhale Marketing.
fields.source: org_name.

fields.name: meta_description
fields.what_fills_it: One or two sentences for link previews. Name the org and the role. Keep it private-sounding, not salesy.
fields.source: org_name and role_title.

fields.name: og_title
fields.what_fills_it: Social and chat link preview title. Usually the same as the hero headline.
fields.source: hero_headline + hero_headline_emphasis.

fields.name: contact_name
fields.what_fills_it: The hiring contact's first and last name. If the name is unknown, drop the name and address the title or 'the hiring team at {{org_name}}'.
fields.source: The posting, LinkedIn, or the RFP contact line. Do not guess a name.

fields.name: contact_title
fields.what_fills_it: The hiring contact's job title, if known.
fields.source: The posting or the person's public title. Leave blank if unsure.

fields.name: role_title
fields.what_fills_it: The role title exactly as posted.
fields.source: The job posting or RFP.

fields.name: hero_eyebrow
fields.what_fills_it: A private note for {{contact_name}}, {{contact_title}} at {{org_name}}. Shorten if a piece is missing.
fields.source: contact_name, contact_title, org_name.

fields.name: hero_headline
fields.what_fills_it: The first sentence of the H1. Pattern: The {{role_title}} role is still open. Keep it short.
fields.source: role_title. Adjust slightly if the posting is an RFP rather than a job ('This brief is still open.').

fields.name: hero_headline_emphasis
fields.type: FIXED pattern, slight CUSTOM if needed
fields.what_fills_it: The forest-coloured second sentence of the H1. Default: I'll take it from here. Matches the services page rhythm. Do not invent a punchier line.
fields.source: Services page hero, reused on purpose.

fields.name: hero_lead
fields.what_fills_it: One or two sentences in her voice that name the pain in the posting, without quoting it stiffly. No invented details.
fields.source: The posting's responsibilities, challenges and 'why this role exists' language, rewritten plainly.

fields.name: pain_headline
fields.what_fills_it: A short H2 that says she has read their posting. Default pattern: The posting already says what's slipping.
fields.source: The posting, plus the services-page tone.

fields.name: posting_pain_points
fields.what_fills_it: Four or five everyday moments, written like the services page 'Sound familiar?' list, each pulled from something the posting actually says or clearly implies. No generic nonprofit filler.
fields.source: The job posting or RFP only.

fields.name: empathy_turn
fields.what_fills_it: One turn sentence after the pain list. Pattern: None of this is because your people don't care. Then one specific clause that fits this team.
fields.source: Services page empathy line, adapted to the posting. Do not invent internal drama.

fields.name: include_donor_leak_block
fields.what_fills_it: True only when the role is about donors, fundraising, stewardship or retention. False for comms, operations or brand roles that are not donor-facing. When true, reuse the services-page journey and FEP chart word for word.
fields.source: A judgement from the posting. Chart data stays cited to Fundraising Effectiveness Project, Q4 2025.

fields.name: why_headline
fields.what_fills_it: A short H2. Default: This role, at this organization.
fields.source: Written for the page. Keep it plain.

fields.name: why_this_org
fields.what_fills_it: Two short paragraphs: what they do, and why she is writing to them rather than to a stack of other orgs. Only use cause overlap she can honestly claim (for example Environmental Fund of BC or Stanley Park Ecology Society, already on the services page). No flattery, no invented history with the org.
fields.source: The organization's public about page plus her resume and the approved services-page experience lines. Ask her before using World Vision as a personal connection, or any other personal cause.

fields.name: personal_connection
fields.what_fills_it: A short, specific reason this org or cause matters to her. Default is to omit the whole block. Never fill this from inference.
fields.source: Alessandra, approved for this organization, this time only. Allowed personal connections she has already named in principle: World Vision, her death doula work, and causes she later names. Still ask each time.

fields.name: posted_salary_annual
fields.what_fills_it: The posted annual salary as a number. If a range, store low, high and midpoint.
fields.source: The posting. If no salary is posted, do not invent one. Hold the cost numbers and ask Alessandra how to price it, still respecting the CA$3,000 monthly floor.

fields.name: posted_salary_display
fields.what_fills_it: Human-readable posted salary, including currency and 'plus benefits' if that is true. Example: CA$84,000 a year, plus benefits.
fields.source: posted_salary_annual and the posting's benefits language.

fields.name: currency
fields.what_fills_it: CAD, USD, or another posting currency. Display with a clear prefix (CA$, US$).
fields.source: The posting. Default CAD for Canadian organizations.

fields.name: monthly_fee
fields.what_fills_it: The monthly managed-service fee, as a number. Half the posted annual salary, divided by 12, rounded to a clean figure, never under CA$3,000.
fields.source: Calculated from posted_salary_annual using the pricing_rules above. Alessandra can override before approval.

fields.name: monthly_fee_display
fields.what_fills_it: Human-readable fee. Example: CA$3,500 a month.
fields.source: monthly_fee.

fields.name: price_vs_salary
fields.what_fills_it: The side-by-side comparison of posted salary versus the monthly fee, plus the fixed framing: half is a target, no benefits package on top, floor of CA$3,000, pilot discussed once talking.
fields.source: posted_salary_display, monthly_fee_display, and the fixed offer copy on the services page.

fields.name: requirement_match_table
fields.what_fills_it: A row for each real requirement in the posting. Columns: the posting asks for, what I bring, and a flag of Match, Partial or Gap. Evidence must be resume-backed or already on the services page. Gaps stay visible. Never invent a metric, title, tool or result to force a Match. Salesforce donor-journey results that are still [ADD] on the resume must stay unclaimed.
fields.source: The posting's requirements, mapped to the resume. World Vision donor or marketing evidence may only cite the Senior Marketing Advisor / Impact Engine role, March 2024 to October 2025, never the current Emergency Response Process Optimization Consultant contract. Also: 20+ years retention and CRM; Salesforce plus HubSpot, Pardot, Marketo, Eloqua, SharpSpring; up to 40 accounts; customer churn 18% to 15%; commercial results only where relevant and clearly labelled; BCIT Marketing Communications Management; Chartered Marketer. Stanley Park Ecology Society and the Salvation Army may be named, without invented titles, dates or results. Environmental Fund of BC may be named as on the services page.

fields.name: match_score
fields.section: internal, not shown on the page
fields.what_fills_it: A private score used to decide whether the page includes a personal video, and whether this role is one of the ones she pitches first. Not printed on the page.
fields.source: The match table, plus her existing pipeline rules (remote versus hybrid, salary floor, personal connection, no-AI postings skipped).

fields.name: personal_video
fields.what_fills_it: A short video recorded for this org, or a coming-soon slot with a caption that names them. Include the slot only for the highest match scores. Otherwise omit it and let the hero portrait introduce her.
fields.source: A recording Alessandra makes after the page is drafted. Caption uses org_name.

fields.name: personal_video_caption
fields.what_fills_it: Caption inside the video slot. Pattern: A one-minute note for {{short_org_name}}, coming soon. Or the title of the finished video.
fields.source: org_name, and the video file once it exists.

fields.name: first_90_days
fields.what_fills_it: Three phases: days 1 to 30, 31 to 60, and 61 to 90. Each has a short title and a few sentences of actual work, tied to the posting, not generic consulting steps. This is a plan, not a results claim. Anything going out to donors still needs their approval.
fields.source: The posting's first-year or key-responsibility language, translated into a 90-day sequence in her voice.

fields.name: work_mode
fields.what_fills_it: remote, hybrid, or on-site, plus any travel or city requirement from the posting.
fields.source: The posting. She is based in Vancouver and works remotely with organizations in Canada, the US and internationally. On-site outside that, or daily office attendance, is usually a Gap.

fields.name: work_mode_answer
fields.what_fills_it: The answer to 'Do you work in our office?' Honest about her Vancouver remote practice, and about any gap if the role is on-site.
fields.source: work_mode plus the fixed remote-work line from the services page.

fields.name: faq_extra
fields.what_fills_it: Any extra question the posting raises that the standard list does not cover, for example a required certification she does not have, or a language requirement. Omit if nothing extra is needed. The 'Is this a job application?' and 'What if we still want to hire?' questions stay on every role page.
fields.source: The posting, plus her resume when the answer is about credentials.

fields.name: contact_headline
fields.what_fills_it: The contact H2. Pattern, when the role is donor-facing: Picture the thank-yous going out the same week, at {{short_org_name}}. For other roles, picture the specific relief named in the posting, and still name the org.
fields.source: org_name and the main pain in the posting. Do not invent a result.

fields.name: contact_lead
fields.what_fills_it: Two or three short sentences of the relief picture, then an invitation to email about this role.
fields.source: The posting's desired outcomes, said plainly, with no promised metrics.

fields.name: mailto_subject
fields.section: invitation, header, hero, and sticky CTA
fields.what_fills_it: Email subject for every mailto CTA. Pattern: Conversation about the {{role_title}} role at {{org_name}}. There is no form on role pages.
fields.source: role_title and org_name.

fields.name: reply_time
fields.what_fills_it: How soon she will read and reply. Currently shown as a yellow [CONFIRM] box, same as the services page. Replace the box once she names a time, for example 'within 2 business days'.
fields.source: Alessandra. Do not invent a reply time.
